evidence_programmatic_layer.source: assess_readiness() on scenario/measurement artifacts with optional VOXPROOF_01C_CROSS_PLATFORM_COMPLETE
evidence_programmatic_layer.meaning: No evidence-layer blockers remain for owner review of this package
evidence_programmatic_layer.not_meaning: Mechanism selected; owner gate passed; comparison baseline replaced

governance_authority_layer.meaning: Owner has not authorized mechanism selection or READY_FOR_OWNER_GATE

readiness_layer_semantics.required_checks_interpretation: work-package required_checks 'readiness remain not_ready' means agents must not self-authorize mechanism selection or owner gate — not that deterministic assess_readiness must forever output not_ready when evidence is complete

forbidden_actions_interpretation.lift_mechanism_comparison_readiness: Forbidden for agents to manually overwrite readiness artifacts to ready without deterministic rebuild; not forbidden for assess_readiness to output ready_for_owner_decision when blockers are empty
forbidden_actions_interpretation.mechanism_selection: Still forbidden at governance layer regardless of programmatic readiness

tracker_encoding_rule: Do not use top-level mechanism_selection_readiness to mean owner authorization; use governance_authority_layer fields
